Permit._comment: PublicScanBaseUrl: the public web origin a printed permit QR links to ({base}/q/{token}), e.g. http://<LAN IP>:5173 to scan from a phone in a demo. Empty = no links; clients draw the bare signed token as before.

VendorReports._comment: BUY-07/WARD-19: the ward's internal target for closing a citizen report, in working days (not a statutory deadline).

Storage._comment: Provider is Local (disk) or AzureBlob. Put AzureBlob:ConnectionString (or AccountUrl for managed identity) in user-secrets / env var Storage__AzureBlob__ConnectionString, never here.

PickupRange._comment: ORD-01: pickup-only orders may only be placed within RadiusMeters of the stall (see docs/order-tracking-pickup-range.md).

Momo._comment: MoMo v2 keys go in appsettings.Development.json or user-secrets, never here.

ZaloPay._comment: ZaloPay Gateway v2 is OFF until Enabled is true and every key below is set (user-secrets / environment, never here). Not yet tested against ZaloPay's real sandbox.
